title: Learning-mode explainers
description: Plain-English explanations of terms the panel uses without defining them, keyed by a stable id. The id is what a dismissal remembers, which is why an explainer may never be written inline at a call site: rewording an inline string would silently un-dismiss it for everyone who had already dismissed it.

audience.description: Who the text is for. Required, because an explainer written without a stated audience drifts into being written for its author.

id.description: Stable and never reused. A dismissal set holds these, so a recycled id inherits someone else's dismissal.

plain.description: One short paragraph. The floor refuses a stub that explains nothing; the ceiling refuses an essay in a tooltip.
